name: Inquisitives
blurb: Questions for skipping small talk. Start anywhere; go as deep as the other person lets you.

howToPlay: Whoever draws the card answers first, then asks it back.
Swipe sideways for another card at this level; swipe up to go deeper.
Go as deep as the other person lets you, and no deeper.

tiers.name: Openers
tiers.description: Easy to answer, hard to answer boringly.

tiers.name: Unguarded
tiers.description: Opinions, and the experiences that formed them.

tiers.name: Vulnerable
tiers.description: Needs some trust in the room.

tiers.name: Intimate
tiers.description: For people who have already gone somewhere together.

cards.text: What do you like to learn about?
What's the last thing you got weirdly good at?
Where do you go when you need to think?
What did you want to be when you were ten?
What's a small thing that reliably makes your day better?
What are you a snob about?
Who taught you something you still use?
What do people get wrong about the place you grew up?

What did you believe for a long time that turned out to be wrong?
What's an opinion you hold that most of your friends don't?
When did you last change your mind about something that mattered?
What did your parents get right?

What's a fear you have that sounds silly when you say it?
What do you wish you'd said to someone?

Who would be hardest to lose, and does that person know?

What question are you hoping I never ask you?

Who have you quietly grown apart from without ever saying so?
What are you pretending to be fine about?
What do you do when you're hurt that you're not proud of?
Who did you fail when they needed you?

What would you want to be doing on your last ordinary day?

When did you first understand that your parents were afraid of something?

What makes you crueler than you want to be?

When did you realise someone couldn't give you what you needed?
What have you forgiven without ever getting an apology?
When did you stop believing an adult would come and fix things?
When has desire made you unrecognizable to yourself?
What do you think I secretly judge you for?
How long do you think we will know each other?
What do you blame your parents for that they will never know?
Which stranger has stuck in your head?
What were you wrong about the first time you met someone here?
What argument do you keep having with the same person?
What did your family teach you about money that you're still undoing?
What kind of tired are you these days?
Who have you failed, and do they know it?
Is there someone you still love who doesn't know?
What death changed you most?
What's the worst thing you've done to someone who trusted you?
What have you never forgiven yourself for?

What do you miss about a time you would never go back to?

When have you felt closest to me?

What do you do that you'd be embarrassed to have filmed?

What's the last thing you got genuinely obsessed with?
What advice do people give that you think is actually bad?
What do you spend money on that other people think is wasteful?
What's a job you've had that changed how you treat strangers?
What did you think adults knew that it turns out nobody knows?
What's a phase you went through that you're glad ended?
What have you owned far longer than you expected?
When did a stranger last make you laugh?
